dict.Unește în jos: sub stratul ales nu e alt: Merge down: there is no other layer under the chosen one (or one of them is locked).
dict.O acțiune ține minte pașii făcuți pe poz: An action remembers the steps done on the picture (adjustments, filters, the filter gallery, rotations, flips, the image size, cropping, selections, filling and stroking the selection, strokes with the brush, pencil and eraser, the gradient, the paint bucket, layers: new layer, copy, merge, flatten, opacity and blend mode) with their settings and repeats them on another picture with one click or with its key. The steps work on the chosen layer (only inside the selection, if you have one); rotation and size work on the whole picture. Selections and strokes are remembered as proportions of the picture, so they land the same way on a picture of another size (selections made with the wand or by color are not, only their inversion). With ⑂ Add condition, the action plays another action depending on how the picture is at that moment (wide, tall, square, with several layers, with a selection). A single Ctrl+Z undoes the whole action. Actions are kept on this computer.
dict.La redare, după cum e poza în acel momen: When playing, one of the actions is played depending on how the picture is at that moment (for example another frame for tall pictures); the step is added at the end and you move it with ↑

templates.Stratul „{0}” e blocat (🔒): pașii de dup: The layer “{0}” is locked (🔒): the following steps were not done.

templates.Condiție: dacă poza e pătrată → „{0}”, a: Condition: if the picture is square → “{0}”, otherwise “{1}”
